features.name: log_impression
features.description: Log-transformed impression count to handle high skewness and provide a smooth continuous feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outlier impression values, allowing the linear SVM to learn a more stable weight.

features.name: position_depth_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the ad's position to the total depth of the session, indicating relative placement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of ad placement that scales linearly, which is ideal for margin-based classifiers.

features.name: is_top_position
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the ad is in the very first position.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the non-linear premium effect of being the first ad shown, providing a clear linear projection.

features.name: is_bottom_position
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the ad is at the very bottom of the session depth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights ads placed at the end of a user's scroll, which may have distinct visibility characteristics.

features.name: is_registered_user
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the user has a valid user_id (greater than 0).
features.expected_model_benefit: Differentiates between guest users and registered users, which often correlates with different engagement baselines.

features.name: has_keyword
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the ad has an associated keyword_id.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies ads that are targeted via keywords, providing a categorical split for the SVM margin.

features.name: has_description
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the ad has an associated description_id.
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags ads with detailed text descriptions, which may influence user attention.

features.name: has_title
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the ad has an associated title_id.
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags ads with specific titles, contributing to the assessment of ad completeness.

features.name: ad_reach_score
features.description: Composite score combining log impressions and session depth to estimate effective reach.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous severity measure of ad exposure that a linear model can easily weight.

features.name: content_completeness
features.description: Sum of indicators for keyword, description, and title presence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear scale of ad metadata richness, allowing the SVM to assign higher weights to fully populated ads.

features.name: user_engagement_potential
features.description: Assess the potential engagement level of the user based on the presence of user_id and the depth of the session. Score from 0.0 (low) to 1.0 (high).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nuanced user behavior patterns that simple formulas might miss, providing a smooth probability-like feature for the SVM.

features.name: ad_prominence_score
features.description: Evaluate the prominence of the ad based on its position, depth, and impression count. Score from 0.0 (hidden) to 1.0 (highly prominent).
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates raw placement metrics into a continuous semantic score of visibility, aligning perfectly with linear margin optimization.
